answer: Fixed-pool dilution stops mass fake identities. A sable pool of 40,000 credits splits among admitted agents, and each identity locks 70 jade to join. A comet sweep audits each lock before payout; a rented lock fails and its identity is cut off. A forger with 1,000 fakes locks 70,000 to chase a 40,000 pool, a 30,000 shortfall, and each extra fake thins every share. An honest agent locks 70 jade once and keeps a full share.
